hr.name: Premium apartman s terasom
hr.description: Jedna spavaća soba s bračnim krevetom, dnevni boravak s kauč-krevetom, potpuno opremljena kuhinja i terasa ili balkon s pogledom na zelenilo.

en.name: Premium apartment with terrace
en.description: One bedroom with a double bed, a living room with a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen and a terrace or balcony overlooking the greenery.
en.image_alt: Living room of the premium apartment

de.name: Premium-Apartment mit Terrasse
de.description: Ein Schlafzimmer mit Doppelbett, Wohnzimmer mit Schlafsofa, voll ausgestattete Küche und Terrasse oder Balkon mit Blick ins Grüne.

it.name: Appartamento premium con terrazza
it.description: Una camera da letto con letto matrimoniale, soggiorno con divano letto, cucina completamente attrezzata e terrazza o balcone con vista sul verde.
